## Summary
Idris Olubisi is a backend engineer turned developer relations engineer, now building agent systems: seven years across backend engineering and developer-facing work (2019 to 2026). He built the open-source Midnight MCP server (10,000+ downloads, 11,900+ AI-agent tool calls), re-architected documentation for AI retrieval, and built SwoopAgent, a multi-tenant platform where around 100 users trade real funds through Claude-powered agents. He founded Web3 Afrika (15,000+ builders across Africa), and his 40+ tutorials have been read 10M+ times.

## Professional Background

### Recent Positions

**Developer Educator, Developer Relations at Midnight Foundation** (Sep 2025 - Sep 2026)
Midnight is a data-protection blockchain enabling confidential smart contracts.
- Built the Midnight MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, downloaded 10,000+ times, which served 11,900+ AI-agent tool calls; a hosted compiler acted as a verification gate so assistants returned code that compiles
- Re-architected documentation with server-side rendering and an llms.txt index, exposing full content to LLM crawlers and AI coding agents
- Developed the curriculum for Midnight Academy, three tiers of zero-knowledge and Compact content (Foundations, Intermediate, Advanced): 1,576 developers enrolled and 1,120+ certified
- Developed educational content on zero-knowledge proofs and privacy-preserving smart contracts, including a 12-part video series
- Ran two content-bounty cohorts (10 to 15 tutorials submitted by about 10 contributors in the first, 20 published in the second), gating every submission on code that compiles
- Built reference implementations and example dApps engineers use as starting points for building on Midnight
- In 2026 Midnight standardised on two official tools, Kapa MCP and Midnight Expert, and midnight-mcp was wound down
- Remote, Full-time

**Founder - Web3 Afrika** (May 2022 - Present)
Empowering Web3 builders in Africa. Backed by Developer DAO.
- Built a community of 15,000+ Web3 builders across Africa to onboard, support, and educate web3 builders
- Organized events and workshops for knowledge sharing and skill development
- Skills: Community Development, Community Management, Team Coordination, Community Outreach, Blockchain

## Projects

### The agent harness, end to end
An agent that acts, the tools and verification it needs to act correctly, and a view over agents while they run.

**SwoopAgent** (acts) - Multi-tenant platform where each user runs a Claude-powered agent that trades real money, on web and Telegram
Agents propose; the backend validates, signs and executes. Closed a double-sell race with an optimistic-lock mutex, Redis idempotency keys and single-transaction writes. A safety layer checks every open position every 30 seconds and enforces stop-losses and a -15% circuit breaker. Around 100 users trading real funds. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Redis, Docker.

**Midnight MCP server** (verifies) - MCP server, built in a weekend, that let AI agents search Midnight code and compile it before answering
A hosted compiler worked as a verification gate, so assistants returned code that compiles instead of confident wrong code. 10,000+ downloads, 11,900+ agent tool calls. Stack: TypeScript, MCP, Cloudflare Workers. https://github.com/Olanetsoft/midnight-mcp

**Agent Lookout** (observes) - Local dashboard for the Claude Code and Codex sessions on a machine, and which of them need you
Flags Claude Code sessions waiting for approval with what they are asking, and jumps to the right VS Code window or tmux pane. Shipped October 2026, 1,100+ npm downloads in its first week. Run with `npx agent-lookout`. Stack: TypeScript, React, Vite, MCP. https://github.com/Olanetsoft/agent-lookout

### More builds
- **create-mn-app** - Scaffolding CLI that sets up a Midnight app with a Compact contract, a local devnet and deploy scripts. 9,000+ npm downloads, now maintained in the Midnight GitHub org.
- **Compact Playground** - Compile API for Compact that adds Run buttons to code samples and was the hosted compiler behind the Midnight MCP server. Original author and maintainer.
- **foundry-axelar-gmp-example** - Reference implementation for cross-chain calls and token transfers with Axelar GMP and Foundry. 500+ weekly adoptions, 55% cut in integration setup time.
- **GiftDice** - Gift exchange and wishlist platform with AI gift ideas, real-time party games and an installable PWA. 3,000+ users across 20+ countries. https://giftdice.com
- **Article Idea Generator** - Open-source AI writing tool that turns a topic into article titles, plus free tools for writers. 60 forks and 10 contributors on GitHub.
- **AudioBoost** - macOS app that fixes quiet video audio with two-pass EBU R128 loudness normalisation, without clipping.
- Other open source: awesome-hackathon-projects (curated hackathon project ideas) and web3terms (a bot that explains Web3 terms in plain English).
